comment: Transfers variable sugar moieties to antaraglycone.

changelog.comment: New entry. Reviewer 1 converted reaction SMILES to reaction SMARTS and added reaction descriptions.

reactions.description: Transfer of two vancosamine moieties to the C-13 and C-13' positions of antaraglycone, yielding Antarmycin C.
Conversion of antaraglycone to Antarmycin C.
Transfer of two rhamnose moieties to the C-13 and C-13' positions of antaraglycone, yielding Antarmycin B. Observed in the delta-antB3 mutant strain.
Conversion of antaraglycone to Antarmycin B.
